newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Lee Kuan Yew set for U.S., Japan visit.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Lee Kuan Yew set for U.S., Japan visit.

text.p: Singapore Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew will visit the United States and Japan from November 8 to 22, the government said in a statement on Thursday.

Lee, prime minister from 1959 to 1990, will attend a meeting of the Daimler-Benz International Advisory Board in New York and receive an "Architect of the New Century" award from the Nixon Centre for Peace and Freedom.
Lee will also visit San Francisco for a meeting of the Stanford University Institute of International Studies Advisory Council.
He will speak to Japanese banking and financial leaders in Tokyo on November 18. He will visit Osaka and travel to Kobe to view reconstruction efforts since the January 1995 earthquake.
